Title: Exception when I iterate through the types of a schema before defining any resolvers etc
Description: I am trying to read a string as a `Schema` and then print out all of the type names in that schema. 

Here is my script:

```fsharp
#r "nuget: GraphQL, 7.2.1"
#r "nuget: GraphQL.SystemTextJson"

open GraphQL
open GraphQL.Types
open GraphQL.SystemTextJson

let definition =
  """type User {
  id : ID!
  handle : String!
  bio : String
  karma : Int!
}

union CommentParent = Post | Comment

type Post {
  id : ID!
  created : String!
  title : String!
  url : String!
  posterId : ID!
  poster : User
  karma : Int!
}

type Comment {
  id : ID!
  created : String!
  commenterId : ID!
  commenter : User
  parent : CommentParent
  content : String!
  karma : Int!
}

type Query {
  posts(page : Int! = 0) : [Post!]!
  profile(id : ID!) : User
}
"""

let schema = Schema.For(definition)

printfn "Found these GraphQL types: "

for graphQLType in schema.AllTypes do
  match graphQLType with
  | :? GraphQL.Types.INamedType as namedType ->
    printfn $" - {namedType.Name}"
  | _ -> ()

printfn "Done. "
```
